title: 生涯スポーツ演習(１００ｋｍ歩行)
subtitle: Academic Exercises on Lifelong Sports

teachers:
SATO Susumu
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: Through learning activities for Athletic club activities, students will:　1．Understand the pleasure derived from sports.　2．Acquire the knowledge and ability to practice various sports activities voluntarily through the PDCA cycle.　3．Learn the things that are needed for social/college life, such as observation of the rules, discipline, respect, a competitive spirit, leadership/followership abilities, responsibility, safety awareness, and communication skills.
advice:
In this course, students aim to achieve the above learning and educational objectives through participation in the “100-km Walk” program.
1. Course Format and Implementation: This course will be conducted in an intensive format and will take place during the 2026 Koudaisai (university festival) period. The walk will start from the Anamizu to the KIT Ogigaoka campus. Participants will walk a total distance of approximately 100 km over two days. Including rest breaks, the total walking time will be approximately 29 hours.
2. Course Overview (1) Basic knowledge of walking: In order to understand appropriate clothing for walking (including in rainy conditions), the fundamentals of walking, and walking pace, students are required to practice long-distance walking prior to the event. Students will learn how to balance walking pace and rest periods, and will also understand that paying attention to the natural environment is effective in reducing mental fatigue. (2) Safety measures for walking: As the walk is conducted on public roads, students must obey traffic rules at all times and wear safety lights, reflective bands, and similar equipment while walking. (3) Planning to complete the walk: The sense of achievement gained by overcoming physical and mental difficulties will become a valuable asset in the future. Therefore, students are expected to repeatedly practice long-distance walking in advance and develop both physical and mental endurance. 3. Evaluation Criteria
(1) Credit certification: Students who do not complete the full 100-km walk will not be awarded course credit.

activityGoals.body: Be able to express the importance of enjoying an active sports lifestyle throughout your lifetime.
Be able to learn the fundamental skills needed for the 100km-walk and use them in class activities.
Be able to evaluate and explain your own situation and improvements in sports activities based on the PDCA cycle
Be able to understand the necessities for social life and implement them in class activities.
Be able to express problems and make improvements that promote a healthy lifestyle by assessing your daily life.
Be able to understand safety management in sports and implement this understanding in learning activities.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Students can express in writing the importance of lifelong participation in sports. (2) Students can acquire and apply the basic skills of the 100km-walk. (3) Students can plan, carry out, evaluate, and improve sports activities independently, and express this in writing. (4) Students can understand and practice skills necessary for social life. (5) Students can identify problems and improvements based on their lifestyle management record and describe them in writing. (6) Students can understand and practice safety management in sports.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Students can write about the importance of lifelong enjoyment of sports.(2) Students can acquire and use basic skills in the 100km-walk. (3) Students can plan, carry out, evaluate, and improve sports activities independently and describe them in writing. (4) Students can understand and practice skills needed for social life. (5) Students can describe problems and improvements based on their lifestyle management record. (6) Students can understand and generally practice safety management in sports.
